fix_decisions.claim_text: assertion glob does not anchor the trailing s (would accept elapsed 5x)
fix_decisions.evidence: cannot manifest: the coordinator's printf format string is the literal 'run-parallel: elapsed %ss' and $SECONDS is always a non-negative integer, so the rendered suffix is always exactly 's'; the malformed 'elapsed 5x' shape is unreachable. Anchoring the trailing s on the multi-line stdout capture is also not meaningful because the capture always contains an 's' (retained logs:, shard roster).

parking_evidence.basis: the malformed suffix is unreachable given the literal %ss printf format and integer $SECONDS
parking_evidence.failing_input: an elapsed line whose value is followed by a non-s character
